about.title: Full Stack Developer in the TypeScript ecosystem, focused on clean code, security and maintainability.
about.lead: Technologist in Internet Systems from UNIPÊ and currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Software Engineering. I develop and maintain internal corporate systems at Bloco Construções, taking part in the whole cycle: requirements gathering with business teams, database modeling, REST APIs and interfaces, testing and deployment.

paragraphs.p1: On the front end, I turn high-fidelity prototypes into reusable, typed and responsive components with React, Next.js and TypeScript. On the back end, I structure layered REST APIs with Node.js, model PostgreSQL and Supabase databases and implement authentication, permission control and Row Level Security policies.
paragraphs.p2: I use AI as a support tool to speed up testing, refactoring and debugging, while keeping review and final decisions about the code under my responsibility. As complementary knowledge, I'm studying Java with Spring Boot, AWS and Docker.
paragraphs.p3: Away from the screen, I recharge in nature and watching a good anime.

bloco.role: Process & Automation Assistant · Full Stack Development

bullets.b1: Develop and maintain internal systems for different areas of the company, from requirements gathering to deployment, maintenance and evolution.
bullets.b2: Build interfaces with React, Next.js and TypeScript and REST APIs with Node.js, including third-party API integrations.
bullets.b3: Model and manage PostgreSQL/Supabase databases, writing and optimizing SQL queries with a focus on data integrity and performance.
bullets.b4: Implement authentication, authorization, role and permission management and Row Level Security policies, following security and LGPD best practices.
bullets.b5: Plan and run tests, fix bugs, support end users and organize deliveries in sprints on Trello.

bullets.b1: Built responsive, scalable interfaces with React, Next.js and TypeScript, applying layered architecture to separate business rules from the interface.
bullets.b2: Created a library of reusable components, reducing rework and standardizing the interface across screens.
bullets.b3: Turned high-fidelity Figma prototypes into working code, with visual fidelity and a focus on usability.
bullets.b4: Worked in an agile team (Scrum), with Git/GitLab versioning, code review and task management on Trello.

projects.title: Projects that show how I build software.
projects.description: Ordered by relevance. The first two are complete applications; the rest are technical tests, APIs and academic work with open source code.
projects.moreDescription: APIs, technical tests and academic work with public code.

techstation.title: TechStation E-commerce
techstation.tagline: Online store for high-performance hardware and complete setups.
techstation.description: E-commerce front end with a category catalog, product page, persistent cart and sign-in/sign-up flow. The project's REST API lives in its own repository, built with Fastify, Prisma and PostgreSQL.

highlights.h1: File-based routes with TanStack Router and global cart state via Context.
highlights.h2: Shipping cost calculation by postal code on the product page and cart persisted in localStorage.
highlights.h3: Sign-in and sign-up forms validated with React Hook Form and Zod.
highlights.h4: Separate API with JWT authentication, transactional orders with price snapshots and OpenAPI docs.

mfrp.title: MFRP · Snack bar management
mfrp.tagline: Orders, cash register and admin system for a snack bar.
mfrp.description: Authenticated application to manage orders, control the cash register and run the business from its own admin panel. The code is private, but the app can be tested with the demo access.

highlights.h1: Order management and cash control in a single admin panel.
highlights.h2: Interface built with Next.js and accessible Radix UI components.
highlights.h3: MongoDB persistence and transactional emails with Resend.

githubSearch.title: GitHub Search
githubSearch.tagline: User and repository search on top of GitHub's public API.
githubSearch.description: Technical test: user search, profile with avatar, bio, location and company, repository list with infinite scroll and sorting, in Portuguese and English.

highlights.h1: Infinite scroll with 10 repositories per page and sorting by update, creation, push or name.
highlights.h2: API responses validated with Zod and HTTP client with Axios.
highlights.h3: pt/en internationalization with i18next and responsive layout with Chakra UI.

psybookings.title: S&M PsyBookings
psybookings.tagline: Landing page for a psytrance booking agency.
psybookings.description: Institutional page with a retro-futuristic identity, background video, testimonial carousel and scroll animations, built without frameworks.

highlights.h1: Design system in CSS variables with Flexbox and Grid layouts.
highlights.h2: Scroll animations with Intersection Observer and prefers-reduced-motion support.
highlights.h3: Testimonial carousel with touch and mouse support in vanilla JavaScript.

techstationApi.title: TechStation API
techstationApi.tagline: REST API for the TechStation store with Fastify, Prisma and PostgreSQL.
techstationApi.description: JWT authentication, product and category CRUD with soft delete, transactional orders with stock control, OpenAPI documentation and Vitest tests.

monitorAns.title: ANS Monitor
monitorAns.tagline: Monitoring of ANS (Brazilian health agency) data with Java, Spring Boot, Vue and MySQL.
monitorAns.description: Technical test with batch CSV import via JDBC, paginated listing and search by company name, tax ID or ANS registration. Layered architecture and JUnit 5 tests.

projetoFilmes.title: Projeto Filmes
projetoFilmes.tagline: Full stack movie CRUD with React, Express and Prisma.
projetoFilmes.description: Final project for a web frameworks course: React front end with Vite and TypeScript, Express API with Prisma and a SQLite database, organized as a monorepo.
